})?;\n534\t\n535\t        match self.store.claim_auto(actor).await {\n536\t            Ok(ClaimResult::Claimed(bead)) => {\n537\t                let claim_event_count = match }\n594\t}\n595\t\n596\t/// Compute a deterministic lock file path for a workspace.\n597\t///\n598\t/// Uses a simple hash (not crypto) of the workspace path. .truncate(false)\n619\t        .write(true)\n620\t        .open(lock_path)?;\n621\t\n622\t    let deadline = Instant::now() + FLOCK_TIMEOUT;\n623\t    loop {\n624\t        match The lock is released when the\n/// file is dropped (flock auto-releases on close).\npub async fn acquire_flock(lock_path: &Path) -> Result<std::fs::File> {\n    if let Some(parent) = lock_path.parent() {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n    }\n\n    let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n        .create(true)\n        .truncate(false)\n        .write(true)\n        .open(lock_path)?;\n\n    let deadline = Instant::now() + FLOCK_TIMEOUT;\n    loop {\n        match file.try_lock_exclusive() {\n            Ok(()) => return Ok(file),\n            Err(ref e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {\n                if Instant::now() >= deadline {\n                    return Err(anyhow!(\n                        \"flock timeout after {}s on {}\",\n                        FLOCK_TIMEOUT.as_secs(),\n                        lock_path.display()\n                    ));\n                }\n                tokio::time::sleep(FLOCK_POLL_INTERVAL).await;\n            }\n            Err(e) => return Err(e.into()),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Unit tests ��─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use
